name: video-generator
description: Make a short video in seconds. Say what it's for and where it's going, and get a silent MP4 of animated text and color, sized for Reels, TikTok, a feed post, or a website, plus an optional B12 website in the same colors.

interface.shortDescription: Make a short video in seconds
interface.longDescription:
Say what the video is for and where you'll post it. It writes a short message, animates it in your colors, and hands over a silent MP4 sized for Reels, TikTok, a feed post, or a website, with a cover image.

No account needed to get the file. Then it can generate a matching B12 website in the same colors.
defaultPrompt: Make a short promo video for my business
Create a 15-second video announcing our grand opening
Make a video for my Instagram Reel
